description: Three long ribbons lie on the tabletop in front of you: two red ones side by side and a pink one next to them. The right hand pulls one red ribbon diagonally across the others to start a braid, then the left hand brings the pink ribbon over and between the red strands while the right hand alternates crossing a red strand back over the center; both hands keep switching which ribbon they hold, tightening and smoothing the developing braid as it extends toward the viewer.
